g.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Provisional: fitted to past weather, forecast on ensemble weather, screening run. Left: weekday daily profile of GAM-K's fit at the 2025-07-01 cut. Middle: the pinned solar capacity of that fit, in points of effective capacity. Right: weekly mean of the Kalman filter's persistent level over the scored year at day-ahead leads.'

text.tspan: Provisional: fitted to past weather, forecast on ensemble weather, screening run. Left: weekday
daily profile of GAM-K's fit at the 2025-07-01 cut. Middle: the pinned solar capacity of that
fit, in points of effective capacity. Right: weekly mean of the Kalman filter's persistent
level over the scored year at day-ahead leads.
